mapper.sql: id, datasource_code, datasource_name, db_type, jdbc_url, driver_class_name, health_status, enabled, true as credential_configured, 0 as pool_usage, last_checked_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from ip_datasource order by updated_at desc
select id, jdbc_url, driver_class_name, encrypted_username, encrypted_password, enabled from ip_datasource where id = #{id}
select encrypted_username, encrypted_password from ip_datasource where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ip_datasource(datasource_code, datasource_name, db_type, jdbc_url, driver_class_name, encrypted_username, encrypted_password, health_status, enabled) values (#{code}, #{name}, #{dbType}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{driver}, #{username}, #{password}, 'UNKNOWN', #{enabled})
mapper.update: update ip_datasource set datasource_code=#{code}, datasource_name=#{name}, db_type=#{dbType}, jdbc_url=#{jdbcUrl}, driver_class_name=#{driver}, encrypted_username=#{username}, encrypted_password=#{password}, health_status='UNKNOWN', enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=current_timestamp where id=#{id}
update ip_datasource set enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=current_timestamp where id=#{id}
update ip_datasource set health_status=#{status}, last_checked_at=current_timestamp where id=#{id}
